hooks.name: Prevent staging ignored/large files
hooks.description: Prevents accidentally committing large artifacts or gitignored files. Applies to all team members.

action.prompt:
If this command involves `git add` or `git commit`, verify BEFORE executing:
1. No files matching graph/, *.parquet, data/raw/, *.pdf, outputs/, *.pkl are staged
2. No individual file exceeds 100KB
3. The command does not use `git add .` or `git add -A` (prefer explicit file names)
If violated, refuse and explain. Otherwise proceed normally.
